standard_prerequisites.use: Univalence, function extensionality, higher-inductive pushouts, set quotients,0-truncation and path groupoid operations. The word-code construction and its compatibility are part of the original retained proof.

core_obligations: Construct the four endpoint code sets as word quotients and supply the compatible equivalences needed for double pushout induction.
Define encode and decode, check quotient/transport compatibility and identify both composites by truncation and path/word induction.

proof_roadmap.step: Construct the four endpoint code sets as word quotients and supply the compatible equivalences needed for double pushout induction.
Define encode and decode, check quotient/transport compatibility and identify both composites by truncation and path/word induction.

difficulty_reason: The theorem computes the entire fundamental groupoid for an arbitrary homotopy pushout. The dependent word quotient and coherent encode/decode construction provide H2 obligations beyond the ordinary set-theoretic group pushout formula.

compared.difference: Migrates this unpublished research claim once using the actual fixed official source; no second count beside the old record.
Homogeneous Freudenthal algebras/anisotropic quadratic forms is only a name collision, not suspension connectivity.
Hypercubical manifolds has a cubical presentation claim, not any of these three numbered book theorems.

dedup.scope: Exact book labels and source identities checked against public/retired/preparation and research-overlap metadata; the three selected statements concern distinct constructions, not alternate proofs. Old mispaired Freudenthal text excluded as a primary proof.
